请至少填写一个作业步骤。: Add at least one coursework step.
从真实需求出发，设计并验证交互体验。: Design and evaluate interactions around real needs.
理解模型、评估方法与数据驱动的决策。: Understand models, evaluation and data-driven decisions.
阅读史料，建立有依据的历史论证。: Read historical sources and build evidence-based arguments.
比较政策工具，分析证据与公共决策。: Compare policy instruments, evidence and public decisions.
课堂演示作业，要求与日期均为示例。: Demonstration coursework. Requirements and dates are examples.
把模糊的设计目标转换成可研究的问题。: Turn a broad design goal into a researchable question.
关注用户活动与使用情境: Focus on user activities and context
避免预设某个界面更好: Avoid assuming one interface is better
阅读第一页的研究问题定义: Read the research question definition on page one
用一句话写出希望了解的用户活动: Describe the user activity you want to understand in one sentence
哪一个研究问题更适合开展访谈？: Which research question is better suited to an interview?
用户如何调整临时改变的行程？: How do users adjust a trip when plans change?
用户是否应该使用新功能？: Should users adopt the new feature?
怎样证明我的设计正确？: How can I prove my design is right?
关注真实活动的问题允许参与者提供多种经验，不预设结论。: A question about real activities allows different experiences without assuming the conclusion.
用主题提纲保持方向，用追问理解具体经历。: Use a topic guide for direction and follow-ups to explore experiences.
半结构化访谈保留追问空间: Semi-structured interviews leave room for follow-ups
将一个封闭问题改成开放问题: Rewrite a closed question as an open question
只能按固定顺序提问: Questions must follow a fixed order
使用主题提纲并灵活追问: A topic guide with flexible follow-ups
课件第二页说明了灵活的主题提纲和追问。: Page two describes a flexible topic guide and follow-up questions.
保留参与者原话，并将自己的解释单独记录。: Preserve participants' words and record your interpretation separately.
观察、陈述与研究者解释应区分: Distinguish observations, statements and researcher interpretations
核对知情同意要说明的内容: Review what informed consent needs to explain
为一条访谈摘录分别写事实与解释: Separate fact and interpretation in an interview excerpt
整理访谈时应当怎样记录？: How should interview evidence be recorded?
混合原话与分析以简化记录: Mix quotes with analysis to simplify notes
第三页明确要求区分这些不同类型的证据。: Page three explicitly distinguishes these types of evidence.
区分训练、验证和测试数据的用途。: Distinguish the purposes of training, validation and test data.
测试集用于最终评估: Test data is reserved for final evaluation
为三个数据集分别写下用途: Write down each data split's purpose
检查实验是否反复使用测试集选模型: Check whether test data has been reused for model selection
哪一份数据用于模型选择？: Which data split supports model selection?
验证集支持模型选择，测试集应保留到最终评估。: Validation supports selection; reserve the test set for final evaluation.
根据任务中不同错误的代价来选择指标。: Choose metrics based on the costs of different errors.
Accuracy 衡量整体预测正确比例: Accuracy measures the overall fraction of correct predictions
Precision 与 Recall 关注不同的正类问题: Precision and recall address different aspects of positive predictions
比较三个指标的定义: Compare the definitions of the three metrics
说明遗漏正类代价较高时要关注什么: Explain what matters when missing positives is costly
预测正类中实际正类的比例: The fraction of predicted positives that are actually positive
所有预测中正确的比例: The fraction of all predictions that are correct
实际正类中被检测到的比例: The fraction of actual positives that are detected
Recall 关注实际正类有多少被模型检测到。: Recall measures how many actual positives are detected.
通过训练与验证表现的差异检查泛化。: Compare training and validation performance to check generalisation.
训练表现好不代表泛化好: Good training performance does not establish generalisation
正则化效果需要独立验证: Regularisation must be evaluated on held-out data
提出一个可验证的改进方法: Propose an improvement that can be evaluated
训练表现很好，验证表现明显较差: Strong training results but much weaker validation results
过拟合指拟合了训练特有的模式，而不能很好地泛化。: Overfitting captures training-specific patterns that fail to generalise.
先了解谁在何时、为谁、出于什么目的留下材料。: Establish who created the material, when, for whom and why.
一手史料来自所研究的时期或活动: Primary sources come from the period or activity studied
一手不等于完全准确: Primary does not mean entirely accurate
记录作者、受众和目的: Record the creator, audience and purpose
指出一个需要进一步核对的陈述: Identify a statement requiring further checks
阅读一手史料时首先应关注什么？: What should you establish when reading a primary source?
文字是否足够长: Whether the text is long enough
是否提供唯一正确结论: Whether it gives the only correct conclusion
第一页提出了作者、受众与目的三个阅读问题。: Page one asks about the creator, audience and purpose.
把史料放回其产生的情境中理解。: Interpret the source within its historical context.
作者的角色影响其视角: The creator's role shapes their perspective
材料缺失某种声音不能直接证明其不存在: An absent voice is not proof of an absent role
材料没有记载某群体意味着什么？: What follows if a source does not mention a group?
群体一定没有参与: The group definitely did not participate
无需研究该群体: The group need not be studied
需要更多证据才能判断: More evidence is needed to judge
课件强调，声音缺失不能直接推导出群体没有参与。: An absent voice cannot establish that a group did not participate.
比较不同来源，将具体证据与论点连接。: Compare sources and connect specific evidence to claims.
比较两条材料的异同: Compare similarities and differences between two sources
用一条具体证据支持自己的论点: Support a claim with specific evidence
怎样构建更可靠的历史论证？: How can a historical argument become more reliable?
只引用同意自己的材料: Cite only sources that agree with you
把单一来源当作完整记录: Treat one source as a complete account
比较独立来源并说明局限: Compare independent sources and acknowledge limitations
第三页强调交叉核对和论证中的不确定性。: Page three emphasises corroboration and uncertainty in arguments.
